@Gideon Sato: Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in #inc-vtg-hartford: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan."

In that same message you noted the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." The channel doesn't record anything else about the guard. The only later mention is Mateo's 11:03 AM message, which says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, and dispatch could see it. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
